title: Municiador (Vaga exclusiva PcD)
description:
At Iron Mountain we know that work, when done well, makes a positive impact for our customers, our employees, and our planet. That’s why we need smart, committed people to join us. Whether you’re looking to start your career or make a change, talk to us and see how you can elevate the power of your work at Iron Mountain.

We provide expert, sustainable solutions in records and information management, digital transformation services, data centers, asset lifecycle management, and fine art storage, handling, and logistics. We proudly partner every day with our 225,000 customers around the world to preserve their invaluable artifacts, extract more from their inventory, and protect their data privacy in innovative and socially responsible ways.

Are you curious about being part of our growth story while evolving your skills in a culture that will welcome your unique contributions? If so, let's start the conversation.

VENHA E CRESÇA JUNTO COM A GENTE!

Estamos em busca de um Municiador para fazer parte de nosso time!

Eleve o poder do seu trabalho como parte de um dedicado time em uma companhia Global, que celebra as habilidades que você tem! Junte-se à Iron Mountain, onde cultura e valores são praticados e respeitados todos os dias! Leia abaixo e veja se essa posição é pra você!

RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Transportar caixas, pelos meios disponíveis (carrinhos ou manualmente), até os locais de arquivo, roteiro ou pesquisa, manipulando-os conforme necessidade ou solicitação;

  • Procurar e localizar caixas de documentos, conforme sistema SKP. Após os trabalhos de pesquisa, retornar estes volumes ao local inicial;

  • Preencher relatórios de suas atividades diárias (formulário OPLOG), conforme os modelos e procedimentos IMB, para avaliação e controle da produção individual e do departamento;

  • Zelar para que todos os volumes e suportes usados sejam preservados nas condições de conservação iniciais;

  • Respeitar as normas e procedimentos de segurança e uso de EPI’s (Equipamento de Proteção Individual) fornecidos pela empresa e higiene do trabalho estabelecidas para a sua área de atuação;

  • Quando não há trabalhos de sua função direta poderá auxiliar os demais departamentos.

REQUISITOS

  • Ensino Médio completo

  • Atenção concentrada, agilidade, proatividade, organização do trabalho e Trabalho em equipe.

Aplique-se agora!

Mal podemos esperar para ouvir mais sobre você! Junte-se à Iron Mountain, onde Cultura e Valores são praticados e respeitados todos os dias!

title: Business Intelligence Developer
description:
GreenLight Biosciences is using RNA to create a world where plants, people, and the planet can thrive together. The company is developing highly effective agricultural solutions for farmers and beekeepers that are targeted to specific pests and degrade quickly in the environment. Our pipeline includes products to protect honeybees and a range of fruits and vegetables. The GreenLight platform allows us to research, design, and manufacture across multiple product categories including insecticides, fungicides, and herbicides.

For more information, visit .

Position: Business Intelligence Developer

GreenLight Biosciences is seeking a Business Intelligence Developer to contribute to the design, development, and implementation of data visualization solutions. This role offers an exciting opportunity to work with and learn about downstream data visualization tools to enable insights and decisions across the organization. The role will focus on visualizing data across R&D, Finance, and Manufacturing workflows.

Responsibilities:

  1. Collaborate within a highly cross-functional biotechnology data solutions team to deliver decision-enabling dashboards for R&D, Finance, and Manufacturing.
  2. Engage with stakeholders to understand best-case data visualization solutions, using dashboarding tools such as PowerBI, Tableau, Spotfire, etc.
  3. Extract and source data from custom systems from third parties, such as TOTVS, and from data warehouses.
  4. Follow Agile methodology to deliver reports and dashboards.
  5. Prepare documentation and conduct functionality tests.
  6. Clearly articulate and communicate results, solutions, and vision to stakeholders and managers.

Required Qualifications:

  1. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Biotechnology, or equivalent.
  2. More than 2 years of working experience in scientific solutions, commercial or public research organizations handling diverse datasets.
  3. At least 5 years experience developing dashboards from complex data models using PowerBI or similar tools like Tableau.
  4. Familiarity with at least two database design and querying languages such as SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL, or Oracle.
  5. Experience with ERP systems such as TOTVS ERP, D365 F&O, Salesforce, etc.
  6. Agility and a solution-oriented mindset.
  7. Strong ownership and commitment to completing assignments.
  8. Excellent communication skills with diverse stakeholders.
  9. Fluent in English.

Preferred Qualifications:

  1. Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Life Science, Biotechnology, or equivalent.
  2. Hands-on experience in data aggregation, cleaning, normalization, and visualization within the Microsoft ecosystem.
  3. Knowledge of financial, manufacturing, and lab processes and operations.
  4. Proficiency in Excel, including developing functions and VBA macros.
  5. Ability to interact with both data and non-data personnel to implement user requirements.
  6. Experience in software documentation and testing.

Greenlight Biosciences Inc. is an equal opportunity employer, committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, genetics, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or expression, or any other characteristic protected by law. This policy covers all employment terms and conditions, including recruiting, hiring, promotion, termination, and training.

Join to apply for the Support Engineering Manager role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
Our regional Support Managers run world-class Support teams – solving deep technical problems for customers around the world on Ubuntu Server, Ubuntu Desktop and on the public cloud. They demonstrate two key attributes: customer focus – ensuring that customers are always satisfied with the service they are receiving, and technical excellence – ensuring that the support team is always up to date with the our technology, and that they perform sound and quick troubleshooting. We are looking for managers for both of our support groups; Cloud Support Group and Devices Support Group.
You'll need to be comfortable in a fast paced environment, able to take responsibility for delivering to customers and enjoy challenges. You will also need to care deeply about your team, their skills, and their career development.
The role entails

  • Management of a professional support team, including skills development and performance management
  • Operational control, shift scheduling, accountability for key performance indicators (KPIs)
  • Ensures that all customer cases are responded to within the SLA, and in a professional manner
  • Act as the customer escalation contact, and ensure that such escalations are addressed appropriately
  • Accountability for customer satisfaction
  • Contribution to the support knowledge base
  • Continuous improvement to the team's processes and support service delivery
  • Hire, develop and train support team to match business requirements
  • Work with the leadership team to drive growth and transformation initiatives
What are we looking for in you
  • Extensive CLI experience with Linux at a technical level (Support, Development, Implementation)
  • Leadership experience, and preferably team management experience
  • Confidence under pressure, with proven track record of high customer focus
  • Preferably fluent in two languages, English being primary one
  • Excellent communication skills (verbal and written)
  • Experience or knowledge of Linux Desktop, OpenStack, Public Cloud or Virtualization technologies
  • Proven track record of contributing to Open Source projects
  • Software development experience
  • Experience in working in support organizations
  • Hands on experience with Canonical's products
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Receber o plantão e proceder a assistência direta aos pacientes, observando, acompanhando, reconhecendo sinais/sintomas e registrando as ações e, ao término do plantão informar e esclarecer a assistência prestada aos pacientes através da passagem de plantão em instrumento estruturado institucional.
  3. Realizar e planejar a Sistematização da Assistência de Enfermagem (SAE) estabelecendo níveis de responsabilidade na execução das ações planejadas entre equipe de enfermagem, avaliando os resultados e registrando-os durante a internação, através das necessidades de cada paciente.
  4. Coordenar processos que garantam uma assistência segura e de qualidade a todos os pacientes sob sua responsabilidade nas diferentes situações críticas, através das diretrizes institucionais, a fim de garantir uma assistência segura, reconhecendo e priorizando de acordo com a complexidade assistencial as situações de emergência e a necessidade de cada paciente direcionando a assistência a ser prestada.
  5. Aprazar e conferir os itens de prescrição médica para continuidade da assistência segura.
  6. Apoiar demais setores, conforme direcionamento de liderança, viabilizando o atendimento de todos os pacientes internados no HSC, garantir as ações de preventiva e corretiva dos equipamentos da unidade, preservando o funcionamento adequado conforme políticas institucionais.
  7. Participar dos treinamentos e eventos institucionais pertinentes ao cargo, e capacitações profissionais para o desenvolvimento de sua carreira na Rede Santa Catarina.
  8. Contribuir para a elaboração e implementação de manuais técnicos operacionais para a equipe de enfermagem nos diversos setores de atuação também como manuais educativos aos clientes e familiares.
  9. Promover e participar da integração da equipe multiprofissional, procurando garantir uma assistência integral ao cliente e familiares.
  10. Participar ativamente de visita multidisciplinar buscando o alinhamento das necessidades assistenciais dos pacientes e familiares sob sua responsabilidade.
  11. Garantir a comunicação ativa junto a equipe multidisciplinar visando facilitar o planejamento e execução das ações pertinentes as boas práticas.
  12. Contribuir com o desenvolvimento do colaborador, através de educação em atividades baseadas em normas, protocolos e procedimentos institucionais, visando a atualização e aperfeiçoamento da equipe de enfermagem.
  13. Multiplicar informações relacionadas a boas práticas assistenciais, treinar e educar junto a equipe multidisciplinar e Educação continuada de área de atuação, cumprindo e fazendo cumprir as normas, regulamentos e legislações pertinentes às áreas de atuação, para colaboradores e acompanhamento de recém-admitidos.
  14. Realizar notificações de não conformidades e eventos identificados visando manter a qualidade e segurança da assistência prestada.
  15. Executar as práticas de segurança através do cumprimento das normativas da NR-32, medicina ocupacional, SCIH e SEST.
  16. Encaminhar os pacientes para o centro cirúrgico, checando o pré-operatório de acordo com o diagnóstico do paciente por meio de ferramenta sistematizada (SAEP- Sistematização de Assistência de Enfermagem Perioperatória) para garantir a segurança de acordo com as metas internacionais.
  17. Instalar e controlar a Terapia de Substituição Renal de fluxo lento: “Prisma” e Hemodiálise convencional através do monitoramento e cumprimento de protocolos de vigilância para prevenir eventos adversos.

INSTITUIÇÃO

Há 120 anos no Brasil, a Associação Congregação de Santa Catarina (ACSC) é responsável pela administração de 19 entidades com atuação social, em saúde e educação, que formam a Rede Santa Catarina. Com um modelo de gestão em que o superávit gerado é aplicado em nossas obras a fim de executar dignamente nossas atividades, a instituição acolhe e cuida do ser humano em todo o ciclo da vida. Ao todo são cerca de 10,5 mil colaboradores distribuídos em diversas instituições de saúde, mantendo inúmeros estabelecimentos de ensino e acolhendo crianças, adultos e idosos em espaços assistenciais, com atendimento humanizado e serviços de qualidade para milhares de pessoas em seis Estados brasileiros (Espírito Santo, Goiás, Minas Gerais, Rio de Janeiro, Santa Catarina e São Paulo).

MISSÃO

Acolher e cuidar do ser humano durante todo o ciclo da vida.

VISÃO

Ser referência de entidade filantrópica reconhecida pela sociedade, demonstrando amor às pessoas por meio de nossos atos.

VALORES

Preservação da vida, Humanização, Dignidade, Transparência e Sustentabilidade.

title: Vendor Manager
description:
Amazon Brazil is looking for a dynamic vendor manager to play an important role within the International Imports team by adding selection, analyzing business data, driving vendor onboarding, negotiating terms and handling promotions. You will work with Brazilian and global vendors to drive all aspects of terms improvements, which includes analysis and projections, as well as direct negotiations with decision makers. Additionally, you will increase product category sales by driving store marketing promotions, negotiating partners to improve selection, and reacting to industry-related economic trends.
You will have excellent verbal and written communication, the ability to analyze and communicate complex terms and margin structures, and work well across other teams including Retail, Finance, and Inventory Management. Candidates who are organized, flexible, creative, analytical, and able to drive negotiations through completion will be highly appreciated. Strong ownership values, a real passion for innovation, and hustle are also key to succeed in this position.
If you are passionate about e-commerce and career growth, this opportunity with Amazon.com.br is for you!

Key job responsibilities

Retail Managers focus on and act at the intersection of customers, vendors, and functional teams:

CUSTOMERS: They rely on specialized teams for customer and category information and insights, and work with and influence other teams to get the category-specific customer needs addressed. The Retail Manager is responsible for holding category-specific knowledge about customers and their needs, emerging product trends, market segment evolution, and new business opportunities.
VENDORS: RM are the ultimate owners of the vendor relationship, with a direct focus on the top vendors that drive the vast majority of sales. They are directly responsible for auditing and escalating performance, improving overall terms and cost structures of the relationship by means of negotiation, and for developing long-term partnerships with new and existing vendors to drive topline and selection fueling category growth.
CENTRAL AND FUNCTIONAL TEAMS: As a business owner, the RM represents customer and business needs in interaction with central teams, projects, and initiatives. The Retail Manager drives central teams for the evolution of customer-facing and internal systems to improve the customer experience from the category perspective. At the same time, they implement centrally driven initiatives within the category to drive CX or cost improvements, prioritizing based on impact and potential tradeoffs, and if need be pushing back on selected initiatives.

A day in the life: Vendor Managers manage inputs by driving selection, securing great prices, and increasing convenience/speed to accelerate Amazon’s flywheel.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- Team management experience;
- Account management, project or program management, or buying experience;
- Experience with vendor negotiations, pricing and promotion or inventory management;
- Master's degree;
- Knowledge of Microsoft Access or SQL;
- Experience using data to influence business decisions;
- Experience driving internal cross-team collaboration;
- Experience with business analysis and P&L management.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience managing large data sets and utilizing them to drive performance and process improvements;
- Experience in vendor negotiations, pricing and promotion, inventory management, and product development.

We are growing our Customer Success team to continue to offer thoughtful, smart, precise interactions across our product portfolio, from Ubuntu to open-source infrastructure and applications. To provide the appropriate level of focus for every customer, CSMs are specialized in one of the following segments:

  • Mass - SMEs or large businesses starting their journey with Canonical
  • Focus - Large companies with established ARR

  • Supporting customers through reactive ticket requests.
  • Create campaigns targeting multiple customers through digital touch-points and activities.
What we are looking for in you
The ideal candidate would display impeccable customer-facing skills with a passion for cloud and data centre infrastructure technologies. We are also looking for:
  • Minimum 5 years of work experience with a strong relation to IT and with exposure to projects related to at least one of these topics: Linux OS, data applications, storage, cloud computing, networking, security, migration, IoT.
  • Excellent presentation skills with the ability to guide a conversation about complex software.
  • Experience building and improving internal processes while maintaining timely delivery to customer-related projects.

We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. Nice to Have

Why Join Us?

Beyond the challenging data and platform engineering problems and working with a high-caliber engineering team, working at Radiant is a major opportunity to impact security teams by reducing their workload and mitigating security incidents quickly. Join to apply for the MÉDICO ORTOPEDISTA - HOSPITAL MUNICIPAL PEDRO II role at SPDM/PAIS - Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Realizar atendimento clínico e cirúrgico em Ortopedia nas áreas: CER, enfermarias, centro cirúrgico, unidade de terapia intensiva e ambulatório do Hospital.

description:
Why join us

TRACTIAN is transforming the industrial world by empowering frontline maintenance workers to achieve more. We’ve fused cutting-edge hardware with innovative software into one powerful platform, disrupting legacy systems and delivering smarter, faster solutions for our clients.

At TRACTIAN, you'll break boundaries, question convention, and collaborate with top talent to drive real change. As a part of our growth-stage startup, you’ll work alongside the founders, shaping the vision, products, and experiences that will define the future of industrial tech.

Customer at TRACTIAN

The Customer team is the driving factor behind lifetime value, retention and expansion at Tractian. We focus on expanding inside existing customers, cross-selling to different products, and building even stronger relationships with our current accounts. Our Enterprise customers are comprised of Fortune 500 companies, such as Hyundai, Bosch, Unilever, Suzano, PepsiCo, and others. Every member of our team directly affects the results of our clients. As part of this team, you will be in contact with clients to understand their needs and help create solutions to improve their maintenance processes.

What you'll do

As an Implementation Engineer at TRACTIAN, you will be responsible for deploying and maintaining cutting-edge Condition-based Monitoring (CbM) solutions for our industrial clients. You will work directly with Reliability teams, ensuring that best practices in asset management and predictive maintenance are effectively implemented.

You will lead the project implementation from initiation to Go-Live, ensuring seamless system integration into manufacturing and industrial environments. Additionally, you will conduct alignment meetings with clients, define deadlines and deliverables, and ensure the quality of project implementation.

Your role will provide clients with reliable tools to optimize machine performance and predictive maintenance. Your expertise will drive our mission to enhance machine reliability and operational efficiency.

Responsibilities

  1. Project Management: Manage all project stages, ensuring that deadlines and deliverables are met within the stipulated timeframe.
  2. Client Alignment Meetings: Conduct alignment meetings with clients, define deadlines and deliverables, and ensure the quality of project implementation.
  3. Technical Asset List Review: Review the technical asset list, ensuring that all necessary information is available for a safe and effective project implementation.
  4. Process Mapping: Conduct a full process mapping of the client's operations, identifying key performance indicators, key users, and internal champions to drive project adoption.
  5. Master Field Installation Plan: Develop the Master Field Installation Plan, a technical reference document that will guide the installation process, prioritize sensor placement, and include the necessary regulatory standards to ensure proper sensor installation.
  6. Structured Handoff: Ensure a well-structured handoff process, guaranteeing the complete transfer of information to internal teams and securing the project's long-term success.
  7. Continuous Improvement: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance system implementations and provide feedback on product development, ensuring solutions effectively meet industrial client needs.

Requirements

  1. Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Production, Mechatronics, Automation).
  2. Strong knowledge of Maintenance and Reliability Project Management.
  3. Solid troubleshooting skills with expertise in real-time monitoring.

title: Jr Product Manager - Content/AI
description:
Join to apply for the Product Analyst - AI/Expansion role at Fanatee .

Stop is one of the world’s most beloved and innovative word games — and we’re looking for someone with an entrepreneurial mindset: a self-starter with a curious, hands-on, and analytical approach, to join our Product team as a Product Analyst.

In this role, you’ll have a strategic seat at the table, acting as the right hand of the Head of Product. You'll work at the intersection of content, data, and operations, helping improve the quality and processes behind the game’s content, uncover insights through analytics, and ensure smooth and efficient production.

This is a unique opportunity to grow in a collaborative and dynamic environment, contribute directly to a game played by millions, and be part of a team that truly loves what it builds.

Key responsibilities:

  1. Improve the team’s working process;
  2. Guarantee the roadmap and deadlines are met;
  3. Encourage open communication within the team and across other groups;
  4. Facilitate backlog execution and improvement, assisting the team in identifying and removing impediments;
  5. Formulate product strategy and present clear, measurable objectives;
  6. Provide valuable input into business cases based on data analysis, demonstrating the impact on key product metrics;
  7. Help drive the product's roadmap alongside the Product team.

Requirements:

  • Experience in product/project management or game development;
  • Self-starter with the ability to manage and prioritize multiple projects in a fast-paced environment;
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with keen attention to detail;
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills;
  • Familiarity with Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools;
  • Fluency in English;
  • Passion for word games, especially Stop;
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, or a related field.

Preferred Skills:

  • Python and SQL for data analysis;
  • Experience with HTTP requests and working with APIs;
  • Database handling and data cleanup;
  • Prompt engineering and knowledge of generative AI models.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive remuneration;
  • Flexible benefits;
  • Health and Dental Insurance;
  • Life insurance;
  • Profit Sharing;
  • Career development support;
  • Casual environment and dress code;
  • A space for resting moments, full of snacks, fruits, and drinks.

About Fanatee:

Fanatee is a mobile gaming startup founded in 2013. Since then, our goal has been to enable people to play our games anytime, anywhere. We believe that quality is the key to success.

Our creative processes are well planned and carefully detailed, and our talent lies in turning great ideas into great businesses: our games hit over 300M downloads worldwide. Our dream allows us to do what we love the most: work with talented, passionate people and give them the opportunity to achieve goals as big as they can dream of. If you want to share this ride with us and join a lightweight, fun, and focused environment that breathes innovation and game culture, apply now!

Nuestro propósito es construir un mundo mejor de negocios para nuestra gente, para nuestros clientes y para nuestras comunidades. Trabajamos continuamente para mejorar la calidad de nuestros servicios, invirtiendo en nuestra gente y en innovación. Las oportunidades de crecer, tener éxito y desarrollarse en EY son ilimitadas.

EY cree en la igualdad de oportunidades y no discrimina por motivos de género, edad, estado civil, credo, identidad de género, orientación sexual, origen étnico u origen nacional, discapacidad o características físicas.

Todas nuestras oportunidades de trabajo están abiertas a personas con discapacidad y buscamos alentar a que se postulen para nuestras diferentes posiciones. En caso de necesitar algún ajuste razonable o apoyo, por favor no dejes de aclararlo en tu postulación.

Acerca del área de Estrategia y Transacciones

Como profesional de Estrategia y Transacciones en EY tendrás la posibilidad de asesorar a inversores estratégicos y financieros a lo largo del proceso de Due Diligence financiero y contable en fusiones, adquisiciones, escisiones y reorganizaciones de empresas, y dando soporte en la identificación de indicadores claves del valor de las empresas target y contribuyendo a mitigar los riesgos inherentes en una transacción de M&A tanto en procesos de “buy side” como de “sell side”.

Podrás sumarte a un equipo dinámico dedicado exclusivamente a transacciones que participa no solo en proyectos locales, regionales y globales para Argentina y Sudamérica, sino también de manera muy activa en procesos de M&A en Estados Unidos, brindando una experiencia internacional muy relevante.

Responsabilidades:

Join to apply for the Software Platform Engineering Manager - Ubuntu for Next-Gen Silicon role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring engineering managers who are passionate about operational systems, open source technologies and cutting-edge hardware to lead engineering teams to enable and optimize Ubuntu for the latest x86, ARM, RISC-V, s390x and POWER systems.
We partner with the world's leading silicon vendors to optimise Ubuntu on their latest platforms. We integrate next-generation features and performance enhancements in Ubuntu while also ensuring a common operating experience for their users.
Engineering Managers should be outstanding developers themselves. They should be completely at home reviewing a patch or a software design spec. You will be expected to drive healthy engineering practices, documentation, quality and performance optimisations as well as lead your team to deliver high-quality design and code.
An Engineering Manager is responsible for line management and career guidance. The ability to develop engineering talent, to represent your team and product from a technical perspective, and to drive collaboration with other teams and customers are all critical to success in this role.
You will have the opportunity to influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.
Location: This is a globally remote role. We have open positions in every time zone.
What your day will look like

  • Lead and develop a team of engineers, ranging from graduate to senior
  • Oversee commercial engagements and support timely delivery on agreed project milestones
  • Participate as technical lead on complex customer engagements involving complete system architectures
  • Implement disciplined engineering processes
  • Integrate and maintain platform-oriented software stacks
  • Optimize Ubuntu for latest hardware platforms
  • Display technical leadership internally and within our external communities
  • Contribute to code reviews and technical documentation
  • Be an active part of the leadership team, collaborating with other leaders
What we are looking for in you
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Fluency in C, C++, and Python
  • Experience with Linux and operational systems software (e.g. kernel or user space)
  • Experience with Debian/Ubuntu or other distro packaging
  • Experience leading software engineering teams
  • Professional written and spoken English
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Thoughtfulness, and self-motivation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long
Nice-to-have skills
  • Experience working with open source communities and licenses
  • Computer architecture knowledge of x86, ARM, RISC-V or s390x
  • Understanding of build systems and toolchains, including for cross-compilation
  • Experience working with customers
  • Experience with board bring up and validation
  • Experience with Linux virtualization, networking or graphics stacks
  • Experience with one or more of the follow
  • Experience with Docker/OCI containers/K8s
  • ing technologies: confidential computing, RDMA, Infiniband and high performance computing.
  • Performance engineering, benchmarking and profiling
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

MISSÃO DO CARGO

Sobre a Vaga:

Na Laços Saúde, acreditamos que o cuidado deve ser um reflexo da individualidade de cada pessoa, promovendo a autonomia e a qualidade de vida dos nossos pacientes. Como parte do nosso compromisso com um modelo inovador de assistência, buscamos Médicos Geriatras apaixonados pela transformação do cuidado à saúde no ambiente domiciliar, seguindo os princípios do modelo Buurtzorg, que prioriza o autocuidado e a manutenção das funcionalidades das pessoas em suas próprias comunidades.

Diagnóstico que Buscamos:

  • Formação em Medicina com Residência em Geriatria, Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM).
  • Experiência prévia em atenção domiciliar ou saúde comunitária será um diferencial.
  • Paixão por promover o autocuidado e a autonomia dos pacientes, com uma abordagem centrada na pessoa.
  • Habilidade em comunicação e empatia, fundamentais para o estabelecimento de vínculos com pacientes e familiares.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma colaborativa e multidisciplinar, integrando ações que promovam a saúde do paciente no seu ambiente familiar.
  • Proatividade na busca de soluções que promovam a qualidade de vida e a funcionalidade dos pacientes.

Sobre Nós:

Na Laços Saúde, a diversidade é o coração do nosso trabalho. Acreditamos que cuidar é um ato de amor e acolhimento, e isso se reflete em nossa equipe, que é composta por profissionais de diversas origens e experiências. O modelo Buurtzorg que adotamos é mais do que um método: é uma filosofia que prioriza o cuidado comunitário, respeitando a individualidade e as necessidades de cada pessoa. Se você é um fisioterapeuta que acredita na transformação do cuidado à saúde, venha fazer parte da nossa equipe e ajude a moldar o futuro da saúde no Brasil. Aqui, cada dia é uma nova oportunidade de fazer a diferença na vida das pessoas.

Tem Paixão pelo Cuidado? Então junte-se a nós!

A Laços Saúde está pronta para receber você!

Vamos juntos cuidar da saúde da comunidade!

Proporcionar atendimento de qualidade, acessível e humanizado através da telemedicina, promovendo o bem-estar mental e emocional dos pacientes. O médico geriatra deve atuar com empatia, responsabilidade e ética, garantindo diagnósticos e tratamentos assertivos, respeitando a individualidade de cada paciente e contribuindo para a melhoria de sua qualidade de vida. Fortalecer a confiança no atendimento remoto, assegurando que cada consulta seja conduzida com o mesmo rigor e acolhimento de um atendimento presencial.

RESPONSABILIDADES:

  • Atuar em consonância com os valores da organização, mantendo conduta focada em resultados do Cuidado, respeitando a individualidade de cada paciente, tornando a assistência personalizada.
  • Registrar no Prontuário do Paciente as informações inerentes e indispensáveis ao processo de cuidar, mantendo-os atualizados.
  • Ser representante da organização, zelando por suas premissas, prestando cuidado baseado em evidências científicas e melhores práticas.
  • Realizar o Cuidado Integral ao Paciente, cuidando com Empatia e Carinho, estabelecendo vínulos e considerando as suas necessidades biopsicossociais.
  • Garantir a continuidade da Assistência Médica por meio da execução do Plano de Cuidado estabelecido.
  • Distribuir adequadamente a agenda de consultas, cumprindo a carga horária e número de atendimentos, conforme o contrato estabelecido.

title: Graduate Legal Counsel - Tech Sector
description:
Join to apply for the Graduate Legal Counsel - Tech Sector role at Canonical

Join to apply for the Graduate Legal Counsel - Tech Sector role at Canonical

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are expanding our in-house legal team, creating an opportunity for an exceptional recent graduate as junior Legal Advisor or junior Legal Counsel. The successful candidate will be a rigorous and effective practitioner with a track record of academic achievement and social engagement. At Canonical they will have the opportunity to work on a variety of transactional matters in the technology and enterprise software realm, as well as the contracts that underpin global employment, contracting and partnerships. In this appointment we are more focused on ability than experience; the position is open to applicants with a relevant degree, but does not have a requirement for extensive work experience. The successful candidate will work closely with our in-house legal team and colleagues worldwide.
Candidates must be able to demonstrate good commercial judgment as well as being organized, efficient, and capable to provide high quality legal and commercial advice. We are looking for a rigorous work ethic, detailed analysis, conscientiousness, and the ambition to identify opportunities for improvement.
Location : This role is home based in Europe, the Middle East, Africa or the Americas, with the option of our London office.
The role entails

  • Report to our global general counsel
  • Draft, review, and negotiate commercial contracts with customers and vendors in many countries across the globe
  • Provide legal support to various internal clients across the company, including Canonical's sales organization
  • Interface with cross-functional teams to support company initiatives
  • Utilize Canonical's contract management system to ensure accurate data is maintained for signed contracts
  • Work with local counsel in many countries to seek and implement advice
What we are looking for in you
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • A degree in law, JD or equivalent, and active license to practice law or current progress towards that
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills with the ability to work in a fast-paced, multi-cultural environment
  • Effective both independently and as part of a team
  • A passion for technology evidenced by personal initiatives and projects
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent drafting and presentation skills
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Appreciative of diversity; polite and effective in a multicultural multinational organization
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Thoughtfulness and self-motivation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
Nice-to-have skills
  • Experience in commercial transactions, intellectual property, or corporate law
  • Leadership and the ability to influence others to embrace new ideas or practices
  • Understanding of the open source software community and values
  • Understanding of the technology industry - silicon, data centers, PCs, connected devices, and software
  • Experience working on in-house legal team and/or law firm
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

A AVSI Brasil ( é uma organização brasileira, sem fins lucrativos, constituída em 2007, para contribuir na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas que vivem em situações de vulnerabilidade. description:
Kaizen Gaming, the team powering Betano, is one of the biggest GameTech companies in the world, operating in 19 markets.We always aim to leverage cutting-edge technology, providing the best experience to our millions of customers who trust us for their entertainment.

We are a diverse team of more than 2.700 Kaizeners, from 40+ nationalities spreading across 3 continents. We are an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of race, gender, religion, sexual orientation,or age.

Our #oneteam is proud to be among the Best Workplaces in Europe and certified Great Place to Work across our offices. Here, there’ll be no average day for you. Ready to Press Play on Potential?

Let’s start with the role

We are looking for an experienced and highly skilled Principal Database Administrator to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for maintaining, troubleshooting, and optimizing our MS SQL Server environments, with a strong focus on availability, security, and performance. You will play a key role in ensuring the continuous operation of our databases, particularly in complex, high-availability scenarios such as Availability Groups. In addition, you will bring your knowledge of alternative database engines like MongoDB and CockroachDB, as well as your expertise in cloud-based database administration.

As a Principal Database Administrator, you will:

  • Provide comprehensive day-to-day support, monitoring, troubleshooting, and administration for multiple MS SQL databases, with a particular focus on high-availability configurations like Availability Groups.
  • Diagnose and resolve complex performance and availability issues, with in-depth root cause analysis to prevent future occurrences.
  • Oversee database maintenance processes, including performance tuning , index management, and job automation, ensuring optimal operation.
  • Develop and enforce policies for backup and recovery , ensuring database resilience and disaster recovery readiness.
  • Apply security patches , conduct version upgrades, and enforce strict compliance with database security best practices.
  • Handle support calls and resolve technical issues swiftly, including response to security incidents and operational challenges.
  • Leverage expertise in alternative database engines like MongoDB and CockroachDB to contribute to cross-functional database projects.
  • Manage and optimize cloud-based database environments , ensuring scalability, performance, and reliability in cloud infrastructure.

What You’ll Bring:

  • Solidhands-on experience in MS SQL Server Database Administration in production environments.
  • Extensive experience with MS SQL Server database features, including Jobs Scheduling, Monitoring, Patching, Backup/Recovery, Replication, Availability Groups , and Always On configurations.
  • Proven expertise in diagnosing and resolving performance bottlenecks and availability issues .
  • Solid understanding of alternative database engines like PostgreSQL , MongoDB and CockroachDB , with practical experience in their administration and troubleshooting.
  • Proficiency in cloud database administration , with experience in cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
  • Fluency in English , both written and verbal, with excellent communication skills.
  • Strong teamwork, analytical thinking, and problem-solving abilities, alongside a proactive approach to continuous learning.
  • A commitment to mentoring and supporting junior team members.

title: Vice President of Research
description:
Why the American University of Iraq—Baghdad?
Opening its doors in January 2021, the new American University of Iraq—Baghdad (AUIB) began as a dream of influential individuals in Iraqi and United States business, industry and government who want to see a world-class institution of higher learning established in the city, reminiscent of the days when Baghdad was an educational mecca and flourishing capital of the Muslim world. With a great library, palatial college buildings and student centers, state-of-the-art classrooms, laboratories, and athletic facilities, AUIB will be a beautiful campus, attracting students, faculty, and staff from throughout the world. We invite you to join us in this exciting new venture.

This position will report directly to the University President

Job Title: Vice President of Research

Department: Office of Research

Job Summary: The Vice President of Research plays a critical leadership role in advancing the research agenda of AUIB. This position is responsible for providing strategic direction, oversight, and coordination of all research activities within the university. The Vice President of Research works closely with faculty, staff, and external partners to promote a culture of research excellence and innovation.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership:

  • Develop and implement a comprehensive research strategy aligned with the university’s mission and goals.
  • Identify emerging research trends and opportunities and guide the university’s research priorities accordingly.
  • Foster a culture of research excellence, integrity, and collaboration across all academic departments and disciplines.

Administration:

  • Oversee the Research Office and all university research operations.
  • Develop university research themes and foster new research initiatives.
  • Delegate regulatory responsibility to appropriate university units.
  • Oversee all research centers, institutes, and appropriate shared or core research facilities.
  • Oversee research partnerships with industry, government, and partner institutions.
  • Represent the university at appropriate research initiatives/collaborations and programs.
  • Represent the university on the appropriate national and international research committees.
  • Communicate and report on the state of the research enterprise.
  • Develop and ensure the maintenance of policies and procedures and fiscal responsibilities for the Research Office and all pre- and post-grant award activities.
  • Ensure university membership in the appropriate professional research associations.
  • Oversee the outstanding faculty and student research awards.

Research Funding And Grants:

  • Identify and pursue external funding opportunities, grants, and partnerships to support research activities.
  • Provide guidance and support to faculty in the preparation and submission of research grant proposals.
  • Oversee the administration of research grants, ensuring compliance with funding agency requirements.

Research Conduct:

Human Research Participants:

  • Ensure the University’s human research participant protection program.
  • Ensure stakeholders and affiliates have adequate resources and appropriate oversight.
  • Receive and assess reports of non-compliance.
  • Place limitations or conditions on an investigator’s or research staff’s privilege to conduct human research.
  • Ensure that University officials cannot approve human research not by one of the Institution’s IRBs.
  • Disallow research approved by the Institution’s IRB or an external IRB.
  • Execute the education and training of personnel in support of an ethical human research participants program.

Animal Subjects:

  • Execute a humane and ethical animal welfare program in compliance with applicable laws, regulations, policies and procedures.
  • Communicate non-compliance to appropriate regulatory bodies.
  • Execute the education and training of personnel in support of humane animal care and use.
  • Establish a university animal care and use committee.

Research Safety and Integrity:

  • Support compliance of all government environmental, health, and safety regulations.
  • Ensure the education and training of personnel in safe research practices.
  • Promote a culture of research integrity.
  • Ensure secure and ethical data use, data confidentiality, and compliant data management, sharing, ownership, and retention practices.
  • Promote compliance for responsible and ethical conduct of research professional development and training requirements.

Patents and Inventions:

  • Promote and support a culture of innovation and entrepreneurship.
  • Oversee policies and procedures on royalties and royalty sharing.
  • Oversee the office of IP.

Research Funding:

  • Ensure high quality and high volume of research applications.
  • Oversee the grant application priorities and submissions.
  • Engage with the government and industry to establish partnerships for sponsored research.

Faculty Support And Development:

  • Collaborate with academic departments to recruit, retain, and support research-active faculty.
  • Promote faculty development in research, including mentoring, training, and facilitating interdisciplinary collaborations.
  • Recognize and reward outstanding research achievements among faculty.
  • Research Infrastructure and Resources:
  • Ensure the availability of state-of-the-art research facilities, equipment, and resources for faculty and students.
  • Manage and allocate research space and resources efficiently.

Application Requirements for Positions at the American University of Iraq—Baghdad:

Required:

To be considered for any role at the American University of Iraq—Baghdad (AUIB), applicants are required to submit the following documents:

  • Cover letter: This should detail how your skills and experience align with the specific requirements of the position you are applying for.
  • Resume/Curriculum Vitae: Please provide an up-to-date resume or CV.
  • Identification: A valid national ID or passport is required for the application process.
  • Please note that applications missing any of these components will not be considered.

Shortlisted Candidates:

If you are shortlisted for an interview, you will need to provide additional documentation:

  • Educational transcripts and certifications must be translated into English.
  • References: You must provide contact details for three references. These individuals should be those who have either worked with you or supervised your work.

We look forward to receiving your complete applications and appreciate your interest in joining our dynamic team at AUIB.

DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

MISSÃO DO CARGO

Na Laços Saúde, acreditamos que o cuidado deve ser um reflexo da individualidade de cada pessoa, promovendo a autonomia e a qualidade de vida dos nossos pacientes. Como parte do nosso compromisso com um modelo inovador de assistência, buscamos Médicos Geriatras apaixonados pela transformação do cuidado à saúde no ambiente domiciliar, seguindo os princípios do modelo Buurtzorg, que prioriza o autocuidado e a manutenção das funcionalidades das pessoas em suas próprias comunidades.

  • Proatividade na busca de soluções que promovam a qualidade de vida e a funcionalidade dos pacientes.

Sobre Nós:

Na Laços Saúde, a diversidade é o coração do nosso trabalho. Acreditamos que cuidar é um ato de amor e acolhimento, e isso se reflete em nossa equipe, que é composta por profissionais de diversas origens e experiências. O modelo Buurtzorg que adotamos é mais do que um método: é uma filosofia que prioriza o cuidado comunitário, respeitando a individualidade e as necessidades de cada pessoa. Se você é um fisioterapeuta que acredita na transformação do cuidado à saúde, venha fazer parte da nossa equipe e ajude a moldar o futuro da saúde no Brasil. Aqui, cada dia é uma nova oportunidade de fazer a diferença na vida das pessoas.

Tem Paixão pelo Cuidado? Então junte-se a nós!

A Laços Saúde está pronta para receber você!

Vamos juntos cuidar da saúde da comunidade!

Proporcionar atendimento psiquiátrico de qualidade, acessível e humanizado através da telemedicina, promovendo o bem-estar mental e emocional dos pacientes. O médico geriatra deve atuar com empatia, responsabilidade e ética, garantindo diagnósticos e tratamentos assertivos, respeitando a individualidade de cada paciente e contribuindo para a melhoria de sua qualidade de vida. RESPONSABILIDADES:

St. Luke’s is proud of the skills, experience and compassion of its employees. The employees of St. Luke’s are our most valuable asset! The Psychologist provides counseling and psychological assessment and testing within an outpatient program. Performs assessment, testing for individual, family and group counseling. Coordinates and implements the treatment plan. Provides crisis intervention as necessary. Services are provided to adults, adolescents, children, families, and couples using knowledge and skills necessary to provide care appropriate to the age of the patients. In concert with psychiatrists, maintains a team approach in treating patients. Adheres to professional and ethical guidelines as outlined by mental health care organizations and associations.

DEPARTMENT OVERVIEW:

Gratifying to work with different patient populations.
Opportunity for further didactics and other educational opportunities.
Opportunity to be part of a growing department/service line.
Harmonious, team-oriented working environment.

WORKING SCHEDULE:

Typical working schedule Monday-Friday 7:30a – 4p.
No call, weekends or holidays.
Opportunity to work virtually one day per week.

JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  1. Demonstrates competency in the assessment, range of treatment, knowledge of growth and development and communication appropriate to the age of the patient treated.
  2. Conducting scientific studies of behavior patterns and cognitive function.
  3. Observing and interviewing individuals, recording the interactions.
  4. Researching psychological, emotional, behavioral or organizational patterns and identifying issues.
  5. Diagnosing potential disorders.
  6. Discussing possible methods of treatment with patients.
  7. Researching and writing papers on clinical psychology issues and disorders.
  8. Performs appropriate treatment services to assigned clients. Uses interventions with assigned clients which meet accepted standards of mental health care and reflect consideration of treatment plan. Provides crisis management for assigned cases and is able to provide back up for the program.
  9. Maintains amount of weekly scheduled client hours as required by departmental needs and standards.
  10. Participates as a treatment team member and maintains a current level of psychological theory and practice. Attends clinical supervision meetings and staff meetings as scheduled and comes to meetings prepared. Keeps current with professional literature and trends in mental health. Attends continuing education trainings, workshops, seminars or conferences in order to keep current with evidenced based standards of practice and maintain licensure.
  11. Maintains active communication with identified staff and agencies that share case involvement when appropriate releases are signed.
  12. Maintains appropriate records of service rendered to or on behalf of the client populations served. Maintains clinical records of all client contacts according to QA & I, State and Joint Commission guidelines. Produces an evaluation report which effectively addresses the reason for referral and reflects the sound organization and synthesis of fact, impressions and clinical recommendations. Completes progress notes, reports and correspondence in a timely manner.
  13. Exercises appropriate self-management in the performance of all duties.
  14. Completes client satisfaction tools as required by departmental standards.
  15. Performs thorough Risk Assessment at intake session and as needed thereafter.
  16. Supports community and/or network departments and service lines by speaking at support groups, teaching about mental wellness related topics, providing stress management seminars and like duties as assigned.
  17. Provides Psychological services (psychotherapy via video, tele-therapy through hospital vetted format) as assigned.

EDUCATION/TRAINING REQUIREMENTS:

Must have a Clinical PsyD or PHD in clinical Psychology or related area.
Prefer graduate from a Neuropsychological curriculum.
Prefer rehab psychology or Neuropsychology internship and 2 year post doc.
Clinical training shall include diagnostic skills and clinical interventions which meet accepted and current standards of care.
Must be knowledgeable in Neuropsychological Assessment and Psychological related to Psychiatric Diagnosis assessments.
Outpatient evaluations, Neuropsychological Testing, Report Writing & Interpretation, Feedback, Therapy.
Must be able to perform pre-surgical epilepsy evaluations and potentially Wada’s.

PHYSICAL AND SENSORY REQUIREMENTS:

Able to communicate effectively (both verbally and in writing). Positive interpersonal skills required. Sits stands and walks for extended periods of time. Requires some light lifting. Potential for participation in therapeutic recreational activities.
Sit up to 8 hours per day; 3 hours at a time. Stand for up to 8 hours per day; 8 hours at a time. Walking for up to 6 hours per day. Frequently lifting, carrying and pushing objects up to 10 pounds. Rarely lifting, carrying and pushing objects up to 75 pounds. Frequently stooping and bending. Frequently reaching above shoulder level. Frequently handling, firm grasping and twisting & turning as it relates to performing procedures. Must be able to perceive attributes of an object through touch. Must be able to hear as it relates to normal conversation, high and low frequencies. Must be able to see as it relates to general, near, far, color and peripheral vision. Must be able to speak as it relates to normal conversation and projection as it relates to lectures and presentations.

description:
Technical Project Manager - Telco / MVNO Integration

1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider dedicated to empowering enterprises worldwide to unlock the full growth potential of mobile connectivity. With a best-in-class telecom technology platform, a comprehensive suite of globally viable regulatory licenses, and privileged access to the telecom wholesale market, 1GLOBAL is uniquely positioned to deliver seamless compliance and connectivity solutions. Serving the world's leading banks, corporations, and digital-first businesses—including neo-banks, travel companies, and payment service providers—1GLOBAL connects over 43 million devices globally.

With 2024 full-year revenue exceeding US$100 million, 1GLOBAL is a profitable business generating significant cash flows to fund its ongoing investments in infrastructure, transformation, and growth. 2024 saw major client wins and marked 1GLOBAL's evolution from a multi-market telecommunication provider to a global technology-driven mobile connectivity powerhouse.

Established in 2022 by experienced tech founders and entrepreneurs Hakan Koç and Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL is a European technology leader driving digital transformation in the global telecommunications market. It operates as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator ("MVNO") in nine countries and as a regulated telecommunications operator in an additional 31 countries. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world-class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, 1GLOBAL employs over 400 experts across 13 countries.

Position Overview

This is a key role in the Network Engineering and delivery team, responsible for managing the end-to-end delivery of a range of projects including complex systems integrations across telecoms networks and IT systems in multiple geographical locations and technical environments. This will require working with both internal and external teams to understand business strategy, business requirements and the delivery of solutions according to business priorities and to time, cost and quality. This role is based in São Paulo, Brazil. The successfully hired candidate will receive onboarding and training in Lisbon, gaining valuable skills while experiencing one of Europe's most dynamic and renowned cities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Work with project teams (including vendors) and programme managers to define & agree scope and deliver the design, build and transformation of aggressive parallel deliveries across telecoms networks and IT systems, covering all features of the project both business and technology related.
  • Be business' representative and act on their authority and behalf to ensure delivery of appropriate business outcomes.
  • Work across the business to ensure the right level of engagement from project teams and stakeholders to ensure alignment across all teams driving towards continuous integration rather than delivering individual work streams in parallel.
  • Manage regular and consistent project planning sessions, meetings, and retrospectives, ensuring adherence to existing Project management processes and controls.
  • Pro-actively manage risks, issues corrections and escalations to ensure delivery remains on track to time, cost and quality.
  • Ensure that all project dependencies are identified, communicated and proactively managed.
  • Manage project expenditure and value, ensuring focus on business benefit realisation.

Requirements

Must Have

  • Minimum of 5-8 years' experience in project management role experience, covering the end-to-end project life cycle, ideally with a Telecoms, IT service or consulting company.
  • A background in mobile telecoms or the wider Telco industry sector is essential.
  • Previous experience in large telecom projects in Mobile Network Operators or Mobile Virtual Network Operators.
  • A track record in the delivery of Telecom integration projects, with high complexity, with multiple third-party suppliers.
  • Strong vendor and stakeholder relationship skills.
  • Managing complex resources and multiple teams in a matrix structure.
  • Management and delivery of concurrent projects that vary in scale and complexity.
  • Driven, energetic, robust and able to work independently without supervision.
  • Must be proactive, hands-on and be able to work independently.
  • Commercially oriented and able to manage relationships at a senior level.
  • Demonstrable experience in project management methodologies.
  • English and Portuguese proficiency mandatory, other languages are a plus.
  • Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in Mobile networks delivery projects, from the service provider or vendor side.
  • Previous experience with Telecom regulatory framework including, but not limited to, lawful interception.

Benefits

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 40% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs.
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver's seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry.
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals.
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts.
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field.
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company.
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment.
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry.

1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

  • Know the clients’ rules and Company procedures for well control and blowout prevention.
  • Incorporate the THINK process into all tasks, whether working alone or as part of a team.
  • Participate daily in START process.

  • Call a Time Out for Safety (TOFS) whenever an unplanned hazard or a change in the expected results is observed.

  • Report any incidents, potential hazards or abnormal situations to the Driller or Toolpusher.

title: ASSISTENTE DE PLANEJAMENTO
description:
Join to apply for the ASSISTENTE DE PLANEJAMENTO role at Logic Engenharia e Construções Ltda

Um Assistente de Planejamento é responsável por desenvolver, analisar e implementar planos estratégicos e operacionais em uma organização. Esse cargo exige habilidades analíticas, capacidade de pensar estrategicamente e conhecimento em processos de planejamento. O Analista de Planejamento desempenha um papel fundamental na definição de metas, no acompanhamento de indicadores de desempenho e na identificação de oportunidades de melhoria nos processos organizacionais. Abaixo estão algumas das principais responsabilidades desse cargo:

Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolvimento de planos estratégicos: Colaborar com a alta administração na definição de metas e objetivos estratégicos da organização. Participar da elaboração do planejamento estratégico, traduzindo metas em ações concretas e desenvolvendo planos de implementação.
  • Análise de dados e indicadores: Coletar, analisar e interpretar dados relevantes para o planejamento, monitorando indicadores de desempenho e identificando tendências, oportunidades e desafios. Fornecer insights e recomendações para a tomada de decisões estratégicas.
  • Elaboração de planos operacionais: Desenvolver planos operacionais alinhados com os objetivos estratégicos da organização. Definir metas, atividades, prazos e recursos necessários para a execução dos planos operacionais.
  • Acompanhamento e controle de projetos: Monitorar a implementação dos planos e projetos, assegurando o cumprimento dos prazos, a alocação adequada de recursos e a entrega dos resultados esperados. Identificar desvios e propor ações corretivas quando necessário.
  • Análise de cenários e projeções: Realizar análise de cenários futuros, considerando fatores internos e externos que possam impactar a organização. Desenvolver projeções financeiras, estimativas de demanda e outros cenários relevantes para o planejamento estratégico.
  • Melhoria de processos: Identificar oportunidades de melhoria nos processos organizacionais, propondo e implementando ações para aumentar a eficiência, a produtividade e a qualidade dos processos.
  • Monitoramento do ambiente externo: Acompanhar e analisar o ambiente externo, incluindo tendências de mercado, mudanças regulatórias e concorrência. Fornecer insights para o planejamento estratégico e a adaptação da organização a novos desafios e oportunidades.
  • Comunicação e alinhamento: Colaborar com outras áreas da organização para garantir o alinhamento dos planos e a comunicação efetiva. Participar de reuniões e apresentações para compartilhar informações, progresso e resultados do planejamento.

Requisitos:

  • Formação superior em Administração, Economia, Engenharia ou áreas afins.
  • Conhecimento no sistema Neovero ou SAP.
  • Experiência prévia em planejamento estratégico, análise de dados ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Conhecimento em técnicas e ferramentas de planejamento estratégico.
  • Habilidades analíticas e capacidade de pensar estrategicamente.
  • Excelente habilidade de comunicação verbal e escrita.
  • Domínio de ferramentas de análise de dados e planilhas.
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis e gestão de projetos é desejável.

  • Participar da elaboração e revisão de procedimentos operacionais padrões (POPs) e manuais técnicos relacionados ao controle de qualidade.
  • Trabalhar junto às assessorias na solicitação de licenças e outorgas.
  • Estabelecer e manter metodologia de monitoramento e controles da documentação legal exigida no fornecimento alternativo de água.

Requisitos:

  • Curso técnico em química ou áreas relacionadas;

  • Experiência em análise de laudos laboratoriais e controle de processos de qualidade;
  • Habilidade em análise de dados e elaboração de relatórios técnicos; conhecimento técnico, habilidade de planejamento, gestão de recursos, habilidade de avaliação de desempenho, gestão de conflitos;

Além disso, zelar pela conservação do veículo, cumprimento de prazos e excelência na prestação do serviço, contribuindo para a satisfação dos clientes e a continuidade dos negócios.

Atribuições e Responsabilidades:

● Direção do Veículo
Dirigir defensivamente, respeitando os limites de velocidade e jornada de trabalho, transportando cargas diversas com segurança, minimizando sinistros de trânsito.

● Velocidade
Manter a condução / direção dentro dos limites de velocidade regulamentados pelo Código de Trânsito Brasileiro (CTB), conforme cada via ou área de trânsito.

● Respeito às Regras de Trânsito
Atender às normas do transporte rodoviário de cargas e demais legislações, conforme o Código de Trânsito Brasileiro (CTB).

● Cuidados com Veículo / Carga
Garantir a manutenção e a limpeza do veículo e da carga transportada sob sua responsabilidade, conservando-os em perfeitas condições de uso e higiene.

● Eficiência de Combustível
Controlar o consumo de combustível, garantindo um bom desempenho com base nas médias de consumo do veículo estabelecidas pela Empresa.

● Manutenção do Veículo / Sinistros
Identificar e comunicar a necessidade de manutenção preventiva e corretiva do veículo, incluindo o cumprimento de revisões programadas, reportando registros de avarias / sinistros e/ou incidentes durante cada viagem, em casos de ocorrências.

● Gestão do Tempo
Realizar suas atividades dentro dos prazos estabelecidos, garantindo a entrega dentro do que foi previamente pactuado pela Empresa junto aos clientes, e combinados com o(a) gestor(a) imediato(a) no ato de cada viagem.
Cumprir também os horários e limites de jornada de trabalho, como os tempos de descansos e rotas planejadas, inserindo corretamente cada macro no computador de bordo do veículo, de acordo com instruções e normas estabelecidas pela Empesa.

● Utilização de tecnologias/entrega de documentos
Respeitar e utilizar de forma correta as tecnologias disponíveis para a operação e que não apresentar atrasos na entrega de documentos obrigatórios, como canhotos e comprovantes. Manter-se atualizado sobre as tecnologias utilizadas ou implantadas pela Empresa.

● Apoio na Carga e Descarga
Auxiliar nos processos de carregamento e descarregamento da carga.

● Cumprimento de Roteiros e Segurança
Conhecer previamente a rota indicada pela Empresa e respeitá-la, de modo que possa fazer um planejamento de viagem, reduzindo riscos de bloqueio e outras intercorrências. Seguir as diretrizes do Programa de Gerenciamento de Riscos (PGR) e dirigir responsavelmente, de modo a prevenir sinistros de trânsito.

● Gestão de Documentação
Preencher documentos operacionais que forem solicitados e zelar pelos documentos de transporte, do veículo e licenças ambientais.

● Disponibilidade
Dirigir qualquer tipo de veículo disponibilizado pela Empresa, independentemente de marca de fabricante ou tipologia, tais como sider, “baú”, câmera fria, graneleiro, etc.

Executar demais tarefas compatíveis com a função e requeridas pela Empresa.
